code_improvements.title: Add More Power-up Types Using Existing System
code_improvements.description: Extend the power-up system with new types like Shield (temporary invulnerability), Score Multiplier (2x points), and Slow Motion (slows alien movement). Each follows the existing POWERUP_TYPES pattern with spawn, update, and activate functions.
code_improvements.rationale: The power-up system in powerups.js has a well-established pattern: POWERUP_TYPES enum, spawnPowerUp() for random spawning, updatePowerUps() for movement/collision, and activatePowerUp() for effects. Only 3 types exist currently (RAPID_FIRE, SPREAD_SHOT, BARRIER_REPAIR) but the infrastructure supports unlimited types with minimal code duplication.
code_improvements.implementation_approach: Add new entries to POWERUP_TYPES enum, add color/spawn logic in spawnPowerUp(), add activation logic in activatePowerUp(). For Shield: set player.userData.invulnerable = true for duration. For Score Multiplier: export multiplier value, use in updateScore(). For Slow Motion: reduce alienSpeed temporarily.

code_improvements.title: Add Procedural Audio for Missing Game Events
code_improvements.description: Add procedural sound effects for power-up pickup, barrier damage, and score tick using the established Web Audio API synthesis pattern. Each sound would use oscillators with frequency sweeps and gain envelopes.
code_improvements.rationale: audio.js contains a comprehensive procedural audio system with 15+ sound functions following the same pattern: check audioContext, get currentTime, create oscillators/gains, set frequency/gain envelopes, connect to destination, start/stop. Missing sounds for common game events: power-up collection (no audio feedback), barrier hits (silent destruction), and score increments.
code_improvements.implementation_approach: Create playPowerUpPickup() with ascending pitch sweep (200Hz→800Hz, 0.2s) similar to playLevelStart(). Create playBarrierHit() with short noise burst similar to explosion crack layer. Create playScoreTick() with quick blip (1000Hz, 0.05s). Export and call from respective modules.

code_improvements.title: Persist Game Statistics to localStorage
code_improvements.description: Track and persist game statistics (total games played, aliens destroyed, power-ups collected, highest level reached, total playtime) using the existing localStorage persistence pattern from high scores and settings.
code_improvements.rationale: The codebase already uses localStorage for high scores (HIGHSCORE_KEY in highscores.js) and glow settings (spaceInvaders3D_glowIntensity in main.js). The patterns for load/save are established: try/catch for JSON parse, consistent key naming (spaceInvaders3D_*), and functions for get/set operations.
code_improvements.implementation_approach: Create stats.js with loadStats(), saveStats(), incrementStat(), getStats(). Use 'spaceInvaders3D_stats' key. Call incrementStat('gamesPlayed') in initGame(), incrementStat('aliensDestroyed') in removeAlien(), etc. Display stats in UI panel similar to high scores.

code_improvements.title: Add New Alien Types Using Established Pattern
code_improvements.description: Add 2-3 new alien types (Spider with web attacks, Scorpion with tail strike, Bomber with explosive death) using the established createXAlien() + animateAlien() switch pattern in aliens.js.
code_improvements.rationale: aliens.js has 7 alien types (Octopus, Crab, Squid, UFO, Tank, Beetle, Invader) each following an identical pattern: createXAlien() function builds geometry with THREE.BoxGeometry and MeshPhongMaterial, stores animation parts in group.userData, and animateAlien() has a switch statement with per-type animation logic. The infrastructure fully supports adding new types.
code_improvements.implementation_approach: Add createSpiderAlien() with 8 legs in userData.legs array (follow Beetle leg pattern). Add case 7/8/9 in animateAlien() switch. Update row cycling to row % 10 for more types. Each type needs: body geometry, animated parts stored in userData, material with emissive glow, animation in switch statement.

code_improvements.title: Add Visual/Audio Settings Panel with Persistence
code_improvements.description: Create a settings panel with additional user-configurable options (mute audio, particle density, screen shake toggle) that persist to localStorage, extending the existing glow slider implementation.
code_improvements.rationale: main.js already implements a persisted glow intensity slider: loads from localStorage on init, updates on slider input, saves to localStorage. The pattern is clear: getElementById for control, addEventListener('input'), localStorage.setItem on change, localStorage.getItem on load. index.html has UI structure for controls.
code_improvements.implementation_approach: Add checkbox inputs to index.html for mute/screenShake. In main.js, follow glowSlider pattern: load saved values, add event listeners, export getters. In audio.js, check isMuted before playing sounds. In particles.js, use particleDensity multiplier for particle counts. Each setting uses localStorage with pattern: 'spaceInvaders3D_settingName'.
